attributes.name: User
attributes.description: Written without quotes around its name.

findings.message: 'Web' has no description. C4 asks for a short description on every element, so a reader can tell at a glance what it is responsible for.
'Web' has no technology. C4 asks for one explicitly on every container.
'API' is in no relationship at all. An element nothing reaches and that reaches nothing is either unfinished or left over.
The relationship from 'User' to 'System' names no technology. How two elements communicate - a protocol, a library, a call - is what tells a reader where a boundary really is.
The relationship from 'User' to 'System' names no technology. How two elements communicate - a protocol, a library, a call - is what tells a reader where a boundary really is.
The relationship from 'User' to 'Web' names no technology. How two elements communicate - a protocol, a library, a call - is what tells a reader where a boundary really is.
'Server' is on no view. An element the model declares but nothing draws is invisible to every reader of the diagrams.
